mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS rate does not decline for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index crosses above 237, signaling accelerating inflation, investors anticipate tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not cross above 237 within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained outperformance of demand (GDPC1) over supply (INDPRO) by >2% over three months creates upward pressure on asset prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 leads INDPRO by >2% over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the demand-supply gap widening.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 6.5%, indicating improving labor market conditions, investors anticipate stronger economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross 6.5% within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers concerns about tightening policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not cross above 4% within the next week.

mechanism_narrative: When supply (INDPRO) outpaces demand (GDPC1) by >1% over two months, reducing growth expectations, investors anticipate lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO leads GDPC1 by >1% over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite the supply-demand gap widening.

mechanism_narrative: An employment surge exceeding 1.5 million in PAYEMS signals robust labor market strength, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or PAYEMS does not cross 1.5e5 within the next week.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with FEDFUNDS <1% and CPIAUCSL <237, markets anticipate continued easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the low inflation and loose monetary conditions.
